benchmark_name: CLEF 2025 JOKER Task 2: Wordplay Translation from English into French
humanities_role_explanation: The task targets the translation of puns, a core problem in translation studies and linguistics, where preserving both form and sense of wordplay is the disciplinary competence tested; items are not generic text used as raw data.
benchmark_modalities_explanation: English pun sentences translated into French text; text-only.
analytical_tasks_explanation: Machine translation of English punning jokes into French preserving wordplay and meaning (paper: 'wordplay translation'). Evaluated with BLEU, BERTScore, a pun-location metric, and manual judgement of meaning preservation and presence of wordplay. Pun location overlap serves as a proxy for wordplay preservation.

general_purpose_benchmark.note: Scoped to a single task: English-to-French pun translation in a shared task.

evaluates_generative_llm.note: Participants used LLMs such as o4-mini, Mistral medium, Qwen2.5-14B, Lucie-7B, and Croissant, alongside NMT systems like NLLB, MarianMT, mBART.

quantitative_metrics.note: BLEU, BERTScore, pun location-based metric, manual success counts, Pearson correlation.

summary: Overview of the CLEF 2025 JOKER Task 2 on English-to-French pun translation, covering data, participant approaches, and results from nine teams and 52 runs. It introduces a pun location-based automatic metric and shows it correlates strongly (0.84) with expert manual evaluation, unlike BLEU and BERTScore.
key_findings: Best BLEU on test was 43.33 (Skommarkhos_Lucie_SFT); best BERTScore F1 was 87.42. Best pun-location result was 9.27% (dsgt_o4_mini_multi_agent_discriminator). In manual evaluation 37.5% of translations were successful; the best runs reached 74% and 72%. The location metric correlates with manual scores at Pearson 0.84, while BLEU and BERTScore rankings differ substantially. Rule-based and some other runs overfit to the training data.
dataset_size: 4,087 (1,405 training puns + 1,682 test puns, counted as source puns; 5,838 + 2,615 reference translations)
evaluation_unit: English source pun (with one or more French reference translations)
facets_explanation: French references are human translations by professional native-speaker translators, with manually annotated pun locations; multiple references per pun are kept (up to 20+), and the location metric explicitly accommodates ambiguity. Manual evaluation was done by a single Master's student specialising in wordplay translation. Some data was reused from earlier JOKER editions, but those were built by the same organisers.
results_explanation: Best test BLEU: 'Skommarkhos_Lucie_SFT 43.33'. Best BERTScore F1: 87.42 (UvA_finetunedNLLB-1.3B). The same runs are ranked very differently under the location metric and manual evaluation (e.g., pjmathematician_Q25-14 scored BLEU 100 on training vs 39 on test), but no single percentage-point gap is reported, so the gap points are null. The manual evaluation reports 37.5% overall success.
